name: End bay beside the bus shelter — name unresolved
observations: Compact dark lower fascia and glazed frontage at the end of the Golden Barber/Jewellers block.
Part of the sign ends in CELEBRITY-like wording, but the full business name is not reliably resolved.
Green bus shelter directly overlaps the lower opening and makes unit limits hard to establish.
Upper red brick and light windows continue the corner block.
Keep an anonymous framed shop bay for now; do not invent a readable business name.
unknowns: Full sign transcription, exact frontage width and door location require closer review/another view.
